assertions.assertion: Explains setting IssuerUri forces the same issuer/iss for every space
assertions.rationale: Explains static IssuerUri overrides the issuer/iss for every request regardless of host or path.

assertions.assertion: Recommends leaving IssuerUri unset so the issuer is inferred from each request's origin and path base
assertions.rationale: Says remove IssuerUri so the issuer is derived from scheme, host and path base.

assertions.assertion: Notes that data and discovery endpoints remain separate per space even with a fixed IssuerUri
assertions.rationale: Does not say data/discovery endpoints stay separate per space.

assertions.assertion: Mentions the same applies to Multi-Issuer
